title: Crispy Satay Cabbage Wraps
description: A crunchy and flavorful Malaysian-inspired snack or light meal, featuring crispy satay and fresh cabbage.
instructions: 1. Preheat a pan or wok over medium-high heat.
2. Add the crispy satay to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until crispy.
3. Add the shredded cabbage to the pan and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until slightly softened.
4. Warm the nutty sauce in a separate pan or in the microwave.
5. Assemble the wraps by placing a portion of the cabbage mixture onto a plate or wrap, followed by a spoonful of nutty sauce.
